notes: Edit this file to add/tune factors and rules; the engine is generic. Thresholds are checked top-down, first match wins; 'points' is a fraction (0-1) of the factor weight. 'source' says where the rule comes from ('guide' = memecoin guide, page in 'note'; 'hoodtier' = our own). 'data' lists the adapters that can supply the metric.

factors.label: Top-10 holder share
factors.evidenceTemplate: Top-10 wallets hold {value} of supply (source: {holderSource}; pools, curves, routers and lockers excluded).

rules.label: Honeypot — cannot sell
rules.evidenceTemplate: honeypot — sells are blocked or taxed away (every pool reverts or loses ≥ 50%, or a sell simulator says so; see Verification for each source) — tier forced to F.

rules.label: Liquidity removed
rules.evidenceTemplate: liquidity removed — every pool is dry (< $100 / 0 in-range liquidity); nothing to sell into.

rules.label: Sellability unknown
rules.evidenceTemplate: No source could confirm the token is sellable — capped at C.

rules.label: Mint authority enabled
rules.evidenceTemplate: Mint authority is enabled — tier forced to F.

rules.label: Owner can mint new supply
rules.note: EVM reading of the guide's mint-authority rule (p.17-19): GoPlus is_mintable plus a live owner
rules.evidenceTemplate: The contract has a mint function (GoPlus) and its owner is not renounced — new supply can be minted. Tier forced to F.

rules.label: Freeze authority enabled
rules.evidenceTemplate: Freeze authority is enabled — tier forced to F.

rules.label: LP unlocked (non-launchpad)
rules.evidenceTemplate: Only {lpLockedPct} of main-pool LP is locked on a non-launchpad token — tier forced to F.

rules.label: Owner not renounced
rules.evidenceTemplate: The contract still has an owner who can change parameters — capped at A.

rules.label: Upgradeable proxy
rules.evidenceTemplate: EIP-1967 proxy: the token's logic can be swapped — capped at B.

rules.label: All buyers exited
rules.evidenceTemplate: {uniqueBuyers} buyers and {sellers24h} sellers, and only {curveCirculatingPct} of supply is outside the pump.fun curve (dust < 0.01%) — every buyer wallet is empty. Tier forced to F.

rules.label: Dev sold ≥ 50%
rules.evidenceTemplate: Dev sold {deployerSoldPct} of its buy — −10 and capped at C.

rules.label: Top holder > 3.5%
rules.note: p.22 — Launch mode only; Established tokens use the graded top-10 / top-holder factors.
rules.evidenceTemplate: Largest non-LP wallet holds {top1SharePct} (> 3.5%) — bundle warning.

rules.label: Top holder > 20%
rules.note: p.22 — softened to A for a founder wallet that never sold (top_holder_20_founder)
rules.evidenceTemplate: Largest non-LP wallet holds {top1SharePct} — capped at C.

rules.label: Top holder ≥ 35%
rules.note: p.22 — softened to B for a founder wallet that never sold (top_holder_35_founder)
rules.evidenceTemplate: Largest non-LP wallet holds {top1SharePct} — capped at D.

rules.label: Founder holds > 20%, never sold
rules.note: Largest holder is the deployer's own wallet (EOA), token ≥ 30 days old, 0 swap-sells and no transfer to a pool / router over its whole history: key-person risk, not a dump in waiting — cap A instead of C.
rules.evidenceTemplate: Founder holds {top1SharePct}, never sold in {founderHoldDays}d — key-person risk: capped at A.

rules.label: Founder holds ≥ 35%, never sold
rules.note: As top_holder_20_founder: cap B instead of D.
rules.evidenceTemplate: Founder holds {top1SharePct}, never sold in {founderHoldDays}d — key-person risk: capped at B.

rules.label: Founder started selling
rules.note: The largest holder is the deployer and that wallet has sold (a swap, or a transfer into a pool / router): the normal top-holder caps apply.
rules.evidenceTemplate: The deployer's wallet — the largest holder at {top1SharePct} — has started selling: RED FLAG, normal top-holder caps apply.

rules.label: VOL/MC < 0.8 on a new token
rules.evidenceTemplate: VOL/MC is {volMcRatio} on a {ageHours}-old token — "most certainly a bundle": −20 and capped at C.

rules.label: Low fees for mcap
rules.evidenceTemplate: Only {feesPerMcap15k} SOL fees per 15k mcap (< 0.5) — bundle flag.

rules.label: Same-source funded wallets
rules.evidenceTemplate: {fundingClusterMax} top wallets funded from one source within 2h — RED FLAG: −15, capped at C.

rules.label: Multiple fresh wallets
rules.evidenceTemplate: {freshWalletsTop20} fresh wallets among the top holders — RED FLAG: −10.

rules.label: Most holders are bundlers
rules.evidenceTemplate: The majority of holders are flagged bundlers — capped at C.

rules.label: Honeypot triad
rules.evidenceTemplate: Up-only chart + low volume + few holders — honeypot pattern, capped at D.

rules.label: Significant dev buy

manualChecks.text: Can you state the narrative in one sentence?
Credible humans are posting about it (not bot call channels).
The people posting actually hold the token.
Poster accounts have a real history (not fresh or bought).
The earliest X posts are not older than the launch (no pre-planned shill).
There is an X community with the CA in its bio.
The dev has an X account and it is not hacked.
The dev's track record is clean.
The community posts outside of pumps.

timeMachine.note: The Time Machine is information, not score. It compares the token at its age bucket (+1h/6h/24h/72h, rounded down) with winner and rug archetypes rebuilt from real history at the same age. Its only score effect is the two Launch-mode rules below: at most +5 or −5 points.

summary.note: Conviction vs churn read-out shown in the headline and /api/tier. It does not change the score; each signal is evaluated only when its metric has data.

signals.text: {accumulatorCount} large wallets bought 5+ times and never sold
{earlyRetentionPct} of the first buyers still hold
supply is spread out — top 10 wallets hold {top10SharePct}
{earlyExitRatePct} of the first buyers already exited

chainSets.note: Chain-specific factor sets: Robinhood launch tokens are scored only on signals Robinhood Chain sources can supply (no pump.fun feed / Helius factors). Base and Monad (v3) have their own launch and established sets, built only from fields their sources fill (docs/chains/<chain>.md); factors no source on the chain provides are absent.

zeroActivity.note: When a source answered and the token's activity is genuinely zero (no buyers, no trades, no volume, no liquidity, curve at 0%), these metrics are set to 0 and their factors score their minimum points, status live, evidence 'no activity'. Null stays reserved for a failed source or a field a source does not provide.

removedFromSolanaLaunch.note: v2.3 §3: no Solana source supplies these, so they are absent from the Solana launch set (not null): fees vs mcap (three.ws has no fees field), only-huge-candles (no per-candle trade counts), holders vs makers (DexScreener's API exposes no makers; Helius has no holder count). Their weight moved to dev-buy share, VOL/MC, launch retrace, identical candles, top holder and fresh wallets.

v24.note: v2.4: basics are gates, not points. Mint / freeze authority, LP lock / launchpad, sellable, owner renounced and upgradeable proxy carry weight 0 (a pass adds nothing; a fail is a gate or cap). Their weight was redistributed proportionally to holders, flow and launch mechanics / liquidity; round-trip loss stays scored, in flow.
